1 #!/usr/bin/env node
2 // Gandalf runtime host — the thin runtime ENTRY (Tier-1 CLI).
3 //
4 // THE REAL HOST (journal/0001 + LESSONS.md): read a model's RAW draft → run the deterministic seam
5 // pass (`runtime/seam-pass.applySeamPass`) → validate it with the shipped `assertIncrement1Conformant`
6 // → emit the canary-conformant, honestly-graded advisor output. This is the chain the v1 build was
7 // missing: model-content → seam-stamping → conformant output.
8 //
9 // CONTRACT (see runtime/RAW-DRAFT-CONTRACT.md): the model emits ONLY the raw draft and does NOT
10 // self-assign tiers/stamps — the host applies them via the seams.
11 //
12 // USAGE:
13 //   node runtime/gandalf-run.mjs --input <file.json> [--output <file.json>]
14 //   cat draft.json | node runtime/gandalf-run.mjs            (stdin → stdout)
15 //   node runtime/gandalf-run.mjs < draft.json --output out.json
16 //
17 // HONESTY DISCIPLINE: on malformed input OR a failed conformance assertion, the host exits NON-ZERO
18 // with an honest stderr reason and writes NOTHING (no partial / no forged output). It NEVER fabricates
19 // a finding to make the gate pass — that would defeat the entire anti-illusion spine.
20

53 /** Parse argv into { input, output, cross_model, project }. `--cross-model` is an INTENT flag only
54  *  (W2b): it records that a cross-family attempt was REQUESTED; it does NOT force the output
55  *  `cross_model` stamp or lift any tier ceiling — that stamp is DERIVED from genuine ledger-bound
56  *  refutations inside applySeamPass. Throws on an unknown / malformed flag. */
57 /** Parse CLI argv (exported for E1 hermetics — production `main` is the only other caller). */
58 export function parseArgs(argv) {
59   const opts = {
60     input: null,
61     output: null,
62     cross_model: false,
63     project: null,
64     analyze: false,
65     objective: null,
66     live: false,
67     budget: null,
68     depth: null,
69     tier: null,
70   };
71   for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
72     const a = argv[i];
73     if (a === '--input' || a === '-i') {
74       opts.input = argv[++i];
75       if (opts.input === undefined) throw new Error('--input requires a file path');
76     } else if (a === '--output' || a === '-o') {
77       opts.output = argv[++i];
78       if (opts.output === undefined) throw new Error('--output requires a file path');
79     } else if (a === '--project' || a === '-p') {
80       opts.project = argv[++i];
81       if (opts.project === undefined) throw new Error('--project requires a directory path');
82     } else if (a === '--objective' || a === '-q') {
83       opts.objective = argv[++i];
84       if (opts.objective === undefined) throw new Error('--objective requires a text argument');
85     } else if (a === '--analyze') {
86       opts.analyze = true; // Scaled-Gandalf map-reduce mode (route by CONTEXT SIZE over a codebase)
87     } else if (a === '--live') {
88       // C1 (2026-07-11): the LIVE cross-family path IS now CLI-reachable — the
89       // always/stakes-gated cross-model rule stops requiring ad-hoc import glue.
90       opts.live = true;
91     } else if (a === '--budget') {
92       const n = Number(argv[++i]);
93       if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) throw new Error('--budget requires a positive integer');
94       opts.budget = n;
95     } else if (a === '--depth') {
96       opts.depth = argv[++i];
97       if (opts.depth === undefined) throw new Error('--depth requires LITE|FULL|SPIKE-FIRST');
98     } else if (a === '--tier') {
99       opts.tier = argv[++i];
100       if (opts.tier === undefined) throw new Error('--tier requires Heavy|Standard');
101     } else if (a === '--cross-model') {
102       opts.cross_model = true; // INTENT only — the output stamp is DERIVED, never set by this flag
103     } else if (a === '--help' || a === '-h') {
104       opts.help = true;
105     } else {
106       throw new Error(`unknown argument ${JSON.stringify(a)}`);
107     }
108   }
109   return opts;
110 }

112 /**
113  * L2 lock authority — pure resolve of maxShards/fusionPasses for the runMapReduce call object.
114  *
115  * When locked (any depth|tier lock input): band knobs are authoritative. Caller-supplied
116  * maxShards/fusionPasses are ignored (unlock-only override). Values equal knobsForSkill via
117  * resolveGandalfBand.
118  *
119  * When unlocked: caller caps pass through unchanged (null = pre-band uncapped baseline).
120  *
121  * @param {object} [o]
122  * @param {?string} [o.depth]
123  * @param {?string} [o.tier]
124  * @param {object}  [o.env]
125  * @param {?number} [o.maxShards]     unlock-only override
126  * @param {?number} [o.fusionPasses]  unlock-only override
127  * @param {string}  [o.userObjective]
128  * @returns {{ locked: boolean, maxShards: number|null, fusionPasses: number|null, knobs: object|null, source: string|null }}
129  */
130 export function resolveConsumeKnobs({
131   depth = null,
132   tier = null,
133   env = process.env,
134   maxShards = null,
135   fusionPasses = null,
136   userObjective = '',
137 } = {}) {
138   if (!isGandalfBandLocked({ depth, tier, env })) {
139     return {
140       locked: false,
141       maxShards: maxShards == null ? null : maxShards,
142       fusionPasses: fusionPasses == null ? null : fusionPasses,
143       knobs: null,
144       source: null,
145     };
146   }
147   const band = resolveGandalfBand({
148     depth,
149     tier,
150     intake: { intent: userObjective, scope: depth === 'LITE' ? 'small' : 'large' },
151     allowDefault: true,
152     env,
153   });
154   // L4/L5 safety floor: refuse locked band-thin that zeros or omits seats.
155   assertGandalfSeatsFloor(band.knobs);
156   // Lock wins: never let caller maxShards/fusionPasses invert locked knobs (L2).
157   const shards = band.knobs?.shards ?? null;
158   const fusions = band.knobs?.fusionPasses ?? null;
159   return {
160     locked: true,
161     maxShards: shards,
162     fusionPasses: fusions,
163     knobs: band.knobs ?? null,
164     source: band.source ?? null,
165   };
166 }

174 export function writeRunRecord(record, { skillDir = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..') } = {}) {
175   try {
176     // Provenance discipline: capture is for REAL runs only. The test suite spawns
177     // this CLI, and those children inherit NODE_TEST_CONTEXT — skip capture there
178     // so mock runs never pollute the training feed (same rule as tidy-idy).
179     if (process.env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT) return null;
180     const dir = join(skillDir, 'journal', 'runs');
181     mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
182     const started = record.started || new Date().toISOString();
183     const id = `${started.replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}-${Math.abs(Date.now() % 100000)}`;
184     const file = join(dir, `${id}.json`);
185     writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ skill: 'gandalf', ...record }, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
186     return file;
187   } catch {
188     return null; // capture is best-effort by design
189   }
190 }

201 /** Grade a draft and return the conformant output, or null if it trips the canary (a genuinely
202  *  malformed DRAFT still throws SeamPassInputError — that is an input problem, not a salvageable one). */
203 function tryGrade(draft, cross_model, resolveCommission) {
204   try {
205     const o = applySeamPass(draft, { cross_model, resolveCommission });
206     assertIncrement1Conformant(o);
207     return o;
208   } catch (err) {
209     if (err instanceof SeamPassInputError) throw err;
210     return null; // a conformance trip on THIS shape — the caller degrades further
211   }
212 }
213 
214 /** Salvage the LARGEST conformant subset of a real (non-garbage) draft whose full form tripped the
215  *  canary — a real cross-model/fused draft occasionally carries ONE item that trips a cap / rung-gated
216  *  field / provenance rule. We never emit anything the canary rejects (every returned output is
217  *  re-asserted); we simply refuse to lose the WHOLE read over one item. The output is honestly stamped
218  *  `degraded:true` with a note; the per-shard reasoning narrative is preserved regardless of which
219  *  structured items are dropped. Order of sacrifice (P0 2026-07-25): a SINGLE offending item first
220  *  (preserving every other finding/elevation/nitpick), then a tail-shrink of one forward leg, then
221  *  whole legs in increasing-value order, then finding subsets, then the minimal (empty-arrays) form. */
222 function degradeToConformant(rawDraft, { cross_model, resolveCommission, reason }) {
223   const firstLine = String(reason || 'conformance failure').split('\n')[0];
224   const note =
225     `\n\n[gandalf-host] Grading degraded: the full draft tripped a conformance canary (${firstLine}); ` +
226     `the read was salvaged to the largest conformant subset (the reasoning narrative above is intact).`;
227   const base = { ...rawDraft, reasoning: String(rawDraft.reasoning || '') + note, degraded: true };
228   const findings = Array.isArray(base.findings) ? base.findings.slice() : [];
229   const nitpicks = Array.isArray(base.nitpicks) ? base.nitpicks.slice() : [];
230   const elevations = Array.isArray(base.elevations) ? base.elevations.slice() : [];
231 
232   // 1) P0 2026-07-25 (journals 0276/0277): the common case is ONE offending item —
233   //    drop just IT and preserve every other finding, elevation, and nitpick. The old
234   //    ladder sacrificed the ENTIRE elevations+nitpicks forward layer as its FIRST step,
235   //    which almost always conformed — so any single canary trip silently cost the whole
236   //    recommendation layer (deterministic, byte-identical, observed live twice on
237   //    --live runs; the expensive path returned strictly less advice than the cheap one).
238   let out;
239   for (const [legName, leg] of [['nitpicks', nitpicks], ['elevations', elevations], ['findings', findings]]) {
240     for (let i = 0; i < leg.length; i++) {
241       out = tryGrade({ ...base, [legName]: leg.filter((_, j) => j !== i) }, cross_model, resolveCommission);
242       if (out) return out;
243     }
244   }
245   // 1b) multiple offenders in ONE forward leg (e.g. an over-cap overrun by >1): shrink
246   //     that leg from the tail while keeping the other legs whole.
247   for (const [legName, leg] of [['nitpicks', nitpicks], ['elevations', elevations]]) {
248     for (let keep = leg.length - 2; keep >= 0; keep--) {
249       out = tryGrade({ ...base, [legName]: leg.slice(0, keep) }, cross_model, resolveCommission);
250       if (out) return out;
251     }
252   }
253   // 2) cross-leg offenders: drop whole legs in INCREASING-value order — nitpicks, then
254   //    elevations, then both. (This was the old step 1; it is now a late resort.)
255   out = tryGrade({ ...base, nitpicks: [] }, cross_model, resolveCommission);
256   if (out) return out;
257   out = tryGrade({ ...base, elevations: [] }, cross_model, resolveCommission);
258   if (out) return out;
259   out = tryGrade({ ...base, nitpicks: [], elevations: [] }, cross_model, resolveCommission);
260   if (out) return out;
261   // 3) the offending FINDING cases (with the forward legs already sacrificed):
262   //    single offender, then a shrinking prefix (multiple/interacting offenders).
263   for (let i = 0; i < findings.length; i++) {
264     out = tryGrade({ ...base, findings: findings.filter((_, j) => j !== i), nitpicks: [], elevations: [] }, cross_model, resolveCommission);
265     if (out) return out;
266   }
267   for (let keep = findings.length - 1; keep >= 0; keep--) {
268     out = tryGrade({ ...base, findings: findings.slice(0, keep), nitpicks: [], elevations: [] }, cross_model, resolveCommission);
269     if (out) return out;
270   }
271   // 4) minimal conformant output (reasoning+verdict only) — empty item arrays always conform
272   out = tryGrade({ ...base, findings: [], nitpicks: [], elevations: [] }, cross_model, resolveCommission);
273   if (out) return out;
274   // Unreachable in practice (the empty shape is conformant); stay honest if a seam ever breaks it.
275   throw new Error(`gandalf-host: could not salvage a conformant output (${firstLine})`);
276 }
277 
278 /** The host pipeline. Returns the conformant output object. Throws SeamPassInputError (malformed
279  *  input); a real draft that trips the canary is DEGRADED to its largest conformant subset (never a
280  *  whole-run crash over one item) — the returned output always passes the canary. */
281 export function runHost(rawText, { cross_model = false, resolveCommission } = {}) {
282   let rawDraft;
283   try {
284     rawDraft = JSON.parse(rawText);
285   } catch (err) {
286     throw new SeamPassInputError(`the input is not valid JSON: ${err.message}`);
287   }
288   // W2b: `cross_model` here is the caller INTENT flag only; the output stamp is DERIVED inside
289   // applySeamPass from genuine ledger-bound refutations. `resolveCommission` defaults (inside
290   // applySeamPass) to the real commission-ledger resolver so the gate is ACTIVE in a real run; a
291   // test may inject a stub. We thread `undefined` through untouched so that default applies.
292   const output = applySeamPass(rawDraft, { cross_model, resolveCommission });
293   // The host's guarantee: never emit anything the canary set would reject. The seam pass is
294   // conformant by construction for well-shaped items, but a real cross-model/fused draft can still
295   // carry ONE item that trips the canary — degrade to the largest conformant subset (honestly
296   // stamped) instead of losing the entire read.
297   try {
298     assertIncrement1Conformant(output);
299     return output;
300   } catch (err) {
301     if (err instanceof SeamPassInputError) throw err;
302     return degradeToConformant(rawDraft, { cross_model, resolveCommission, reason: err.message });
303   }
304 }
305 
306 /** Finalize a graded output: return it if conformant, else degrade to the largest conformant subset.
307  *  Shared by the Tier-1 (`runHost`) and W3 live (`runHostLive`) paths so both honour the "never emit
308  *  anything the canary rejects" guarantee identically. */
309 function finalizeConformant(rawDraft, output, { cross_model, resolveCommission }) {
310   try {
311     assertIncrement1Conformant(output);
312     return output;
313   } catch (err) {
314     if (err instanceof SeamPassInputError) throw err;
315     return degradeToConformant(rawDraft, { cross_model, resolveCommission, reason: err.message });
316   }
317 }

319 /**
320  * runHostLive — the W3 LIVE cross-family host pipeline (the sequenced follow-on Tier-1 could not run).
321  *
322  * THE ONE SHARED PER-RUN LEDGER (invariant 1): a single `createCommissionLedger()` is the sole ledger —
323  * `runLiveRefutation` MINTS into `ledger.mintCommission` and `applySeamPass` RESOLVES via the SAME
324  * `ledger.resolveCommission`. The minter and the gate can NEVER be on different ledger instances (that
325  * would make every genuine cross-family mint a false negative). The mint binds each commission to the
326  * exact elevation object the gate then reads (invariant 2), so a surviving, genuinely cross-family
327  * refutation reaches GROUNDED with the DERIVED cross_model:true; a failed/absent refutation stays
328  * SPECULATIVE (honest floor). Async because it dispatches real refuters.
329  *
330  * The live role-routed agent (refuter → Gemini, drafter → Claude) is built via buildLiveRefuterAgent
331  * (routing guard enforced) unless an `agent` is injected (tests inject a stub). Likewise the ledger may
332  * be injected for a reproducible fixture; otherwise a fresh per-run ledger is minted here.
333  *
334  * @param {string} rawText
335  * @param {object} [o]
336  * @param {boolean}[o.cross_model]           the caller INTENT flag (recorded only; the stamp is DERIVED)
337  * @param {Function}[o.agent]                injected role-routed agent (tests); omit for the live agent
338  * @param {object} [o.ledger]                injected shared ledger (tests); omit for a fresh per-run ledger
339  * @param {object} [o.routes]                the route table (routing guard + live-agent build)
340  * @param {string} [o.drafterFamily]
341  * @param {string} [o.refuterFamily]
342  * @param {number} [o.budget]
343  * @param {Function}[o.log]
344  * @returns {Promise<{output:object, dispatch:object[], ledger:object}>}
345  */
346 export async function runHostLive(rawText, {
347   cross_model = false,
348   agent,
349   ledger: injectedLedger,
350   routes,
351   drafterFamily,
352   refuterFamily = REFUTER_FAMILY,
353   budget,
354   log = () => {},
355 } = {}) {
356   let rawDraft;
357   try {
358     rawDraft = JSON.parse(rawText);
359   } catch (err) {
360     throw new SeamPassInputError(`the input is not valid JSON: ${err.message}`);
361   }
362   // INVARIANT 1: ONE shared per-run ledger for BOTH the minter and the gate.
363   const ledger = injectedLedger || createCommissionLedger();
364   const resolveCommission = ledger.resolveCommission;
365   // Live agent: omit routes/drafter → coding/review family prefs; tests pass explicit pins.
366   const theAgent = agent || (await buildLiveRefuterAgent({ routes, drafterFamily, env: process.env }));
367 
368   // Dispatch the live refuters and mint claim-bound commissions into the shared ledger.
369   const { draft, dispatch } = await runLiveRefutation(rawDraft, {
370     agent: theAgent, ledger, routes, drafterFamily, refuterFamily, budget, log,
371   });
372 
373   // Grade the refuted draft against the SAME ledger's resolver — cross_model / GROUNDED are DERIVED here.
374   const output = applySeamPass(draft, { cross_model, resolveCommission });
375   const finalized = finalizeConformant(draft, output, { cross_model, resolveCommission });
376   return { output: finalized, dispatch, ledger };
377 }

379 // ===========================================================================================
380 // W4 (2026-07-05) — SCALED-GANDALF wiring: actually invoke scout + map-reduce from the CLI.
381 //
382 // Before W4 this entry imported ONLY runRouter (context-sizing) and NEVER invoked the big-repo
383 // map-reduce engine — the scout/map/reduce pipeline was built but dead. `runScaledAnalysis` wires it
384 // in and routes by CONTEXT SIZE:
385 //   • a SMALL target → runMapReduce/decideTier returns 'direct' → ONE frontier pass, NO scout, NO
386 //     shard, NO map-reduce ceremony.
387 //   • a LARGE target → shard → scout → map → reduce.
388 // The size decision itself lives in ONE place (runMapReduce → decideTier); this wrapper adds the
389 // CLEVER TWO-MODEL split on top of it.

392 /**
393  * Scaled-Gandalf seat models from UNIVERSAL SEATING LAW (Anchor prefs).
394  * - bulk MAP / scout → REVIEW_FAMILY (standard tier when that family is Gemini)
395  * - REDUCE / synthesis → CODING_FAMILY (heavy tier when that family is Gemini)
396  * Gemini models stay agy LABELS via resolveGeminiModel; other families leave model null
397  * (CLI session / driver default). Never hardcode Claude/Gemini/Grok product IDs here.
398  * @param {object} [env=process.env]
399  * @returns {{ mapModel:?string, reduceModel:?string, mapDriver:string, reduceDriver:string, families:object }}
400  */
401 export function resolveScaledModels(env = process.env) {
402   const families = loadModelFamilies(env);
403   const mapDriver = familyToDriverName(families.review) || 'gemini-cli';
404   const reduceDriver = familyToDriverName(families.coding) || 'claude';
405   let mapModel = null;
406   let reduceModel = null;
407   if (mapDriver === 'gemini-cli' || mapDriver.startsWith('gemini')) {
408     mapModel = resolveGeminiModel({ env: { ...env, TRIO_TIER: 'standard' } });
409   }
410   if (reduceDriver === 'gemini-cli' || reduceDriver.startsWith('gemini')) {
411     reduceModel = resolveGeminiModel({ env: { ...env, TRIO_TIER: 'heavy' } });
412   }
413   return { mapModel, reduceModel, mapDriver, reduceDriver, families };
414 }

416 /**
417  * runScaledAnalysis — the Scaled-Gandalf map-reduce pipeline, wired to route by CONTEXT SIZE (via
418  * runMapReduce/decideTier) with the clever map=STANDARD / reduce=HEAVY split applied on top.
419  *
420  * A SMALL target is answered by a single frontier (HEAVY) pass (decideTier='direct') — no scout, no
421  * shard. A LARGE target shards → scouts (STANDARD) → maps (STANDARD) → reduces/synthesizes (HEAVY).
422  *
423  * `makeAgent(model, role)` is INJECTABLE so a deterministic test drives the whole pipeline with stub
424  * agents (no live agy); omit it for the live agy seam. Returns the raw map-reduce advisory prose (a
425  * PRE-STAGE — the canonical branded output is still the graded gandalf-advisor-1 envelope).
426  *
427  * @param {object} o
428  * @param {?string}  [o.projectDir]
429  * @param {Array|Object} o.payload            the codebase payload (path strings / {path,content} / dict)
430  * @param {string}   o.userObjective
431  * @param {object}   [o.env=process.env]
432  * @param {Function} [o.log]
433  * @param {?Function}[o.makeAgent]            (model, role) => agentFn — injected for tests
434  * @param {?number}  [o.highContextLimit]
435  * @param {number}   [o.concurrencyLimit=3]
436  * @returns {Promise<string>}
437  */
438 export async function runScaledAnalysis({
439   projectDir = null,
440   payload,
441   userObjective,
442   env = process.env,
443   log = () => {},
444   makeAgent = null,
445   highContextLimit = null,
446   concurrencyLimit = 3,
447   depth = null,
448   tier = null,
449   maxShards = null,
450   fusionPasses = null,
451   /** Optional inject for hermetic E1–E4 call-object capture (production omits → live runMapReduce). */
452   mapReduceRunner = null,
453 } = {}) {
454   // B2 L2: locked path forwards authoritative band knobs; unlocked keeps caller caps / null.
455   // Caller maxShards/fusionPasses cannot invert a lock (unlock-only override).
456   const consume = resolveConsumeKnobs({
457     depth,
458     tier,
459     env,
460     maxShards,
461     fusionPasses,
462     userObjective,
463   });
464   const shards = consume.maxShards;
465   const fusions = consume.fusionPasses;
466   if (consume.locked) {
467     log(`gandalf band: depth=${consume.knobs?.depth} shards=${shards} fusionPasses=${fusions} source=${consume.source}`);
468   }
469 
470   const { mapModel, reduceModel, mapDriver, reduceDriver } = resolveScaledModels(env);
471   const target = projectDir || process.cwd();
472   const factory = makeAgent || ((model, role) => {
473     const driver = role === 'reduce' ? reduceDriver : mapDriver;
474     // Gemini seats keep the dedicated agy seam; all other families use the prefs-routed runAgent.
475     if (driver === 'gemini-cli' || String(driver).startsWith('gemini')) {
476       return makeGeminiCliSeam({ model, role, env, target, log }).agent;
477     }
478     return (prompt, opts = {}) => runAgent({
479       prompt,
480       schema: opts.schema,
481       label: opts.label || `gandalf:${role}`,
482       role: opts.role || role,
483       model: model || opts.model || null,
484       driver,
485       env: { ...env, CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE: env.CRUCIBLE_AGENT_LIVE || '1' },
486       target,
487       log,
488     });
489   });
490   const mapAgent = factory(mapModel, 'map');       // REVIEW_FAMILY bulk reads
491   const reduceAgent = factory(reduceModel, 'reduce'); // CODING_FAMILY synthesis
492   const invokeMapReduce = typeof mapReduceRunner === 'function' ? mapReduceRunner : runMapReduce;
493   return invokeMapReduce({
494     projectDir,
495     payload,
496     userObjective,
497     env,
498     log,
499     agent: mapAgent,
500     reduceAgent,
501     highContextLimit,
502     concurrencyLimit,
503     maxShards: shards,
504     fusionPasses: fusions,
505   });
506 }
507 
508 /**
509  * Collect a codebase payload (an array of repo-relative path strings) by walking `projectDir` and
510  * respecting the same gitignore/default ignores the context-sizer uses. Content is read lazily by the
511  * map-reduce runtime (it resolves string paths against projectDir), so this stays cheap.
512  * @param {string} projectDir
513  * @returns {string[]} repo-relative POSIX-ish path strings
514  */
515 export function collectProjectPayload(projectDir) {
516   const patterns = getGitignorePatterns(projectDir);
517   const out = [];
518   const walk = (dir) => {
519     let entries;
520     try { entries = readdirSync(dir); } catch { return; }
521     for (const name of entries) {
522       const full = join(dir, name);
523       const rel = relative(projectDir, full);
524       let st;
525       try { st = statSync(full); } catch { continue; }
526       if (st.isDirectory()) {
527         if (isIgnored(rel, patterns, true)) continue;
528         walk(full);
529       } else if (st.isFile()) {
530         if (isIgnored(rel, patterns, false)) continue;
531         out.push(rel.replace(/\\/g, '/'));
532       }
533     }
534   };
535   walk(projectDir);
536   return out;
537 }
538 
539 /**
540  * C2 (2026-07-11): grade a scaled-analysis report through the SAME honesty spine as
541  * every other run. The map-reduce used to ship RAW PROSE straight to the user — the
542  * one thing Gandalf exists to prevent (map-reduce.mjs's own comment promised the
543  * seam-pass feedback that nothing performed). If the reduce seat emitted the
544  * RAW-DRAFT-CONTRACT JSON, grade it directly; otherwise wrap the prose in a minimal
545  * raw draft (reasoning = the report; zero self-assigned tiers) and grade THAT — the
546  * output is the stamped, canary-conformant envelope either way, honestly marked
547  * degraded (no live refuters ran on the scaled path).
548  */
549 export function gradeScaledReport(report) {
550   const text = String(report);
551   let rawDraft = null;
552   try {
553     const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
554     if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) rawDraft = parsed;
555   } catch { /* prose report — wrap it */ }
556   if (!rawDraft) {
557     rawDraft = {
558       reasoning: text,
559       verdict: 'scaled analyze — see reasoning (map-reduce advisory prose, host-graded)',
560       findings: [],
561       nitpicks: [],
562       elevations: [],
563     };
564   }
565   const output = runHost(JSON.stringify(rawDraft), { cross_model: false });
566   // Carry the map-reduce degradation stamp forward — never silently dropped.
567   output.degraded = true;
568   const stamp = report && typeof report === 'object' && 'stamp' in report ? report.stamp : null;
569   if (stamp) output.scaled_stamp = String(stamp);
570   return output;
571 }
572 
573 /** The `--analyze` CLI path: build the codebase payload, run the Scaled-Gandalf pipeline (context-size
574  *  routed, clever two-model), grade the result through the seam pass (C2), and write the STAMPED
575  *  envelope to --output or stdout. Throws on failure so the caller emits an honest stderr reason and
576  *  a non-zero exit. */
577 async function runAnalyzeMode(opts) {
578   const projectDir = resolve(opts.project || process.cwd());
579   const objective = opts.objective || 'Provide a deep-think advisory review of this codebase.';
580   const payload = collectProjectPayload(projectDir);
581   process.stderr.write(`gandalf-run: --analyze over ${payload.length} files in ${projectDir}\n`);
582   const report = await runScaledAnalysis({
583     projectDir,
584     payload,
585     userObjective: objective,
586     env: process.env,
587     log: (m) => process.stderr.write(`${m}\n`),
588     depth: opts.depth || null,
589     tier: opts.tier || null,
590   });
591   const graded = gradeScaledReport(report);
592   const serialized = `${JSON.stringify(graded, null, 2)}\n`;
593   if (opts.output) writeFileSync(opts.output, serialized, 'utf8');
594   else process.stdout.write(serialized);
595 }
596 
597 async function main() {
598   let opts;
599   try {
600     opts = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
601   } catch (err) {
602     process.stderr.write(`gandalf-run: ${err.message}\n${USAGE}\n`);
603     process.exitCode = 2;
604     return;
605   }
606   if (opts.help) {
607     process.stdout.write(`${USAGE}\n`);
608     return;
609   }
610 
611   // W4: the SCALED-GANDALF analyze mode — actually invoke scout + map-reduce over a codebase, routed
612   // by context size (single frontier pass for a small target; shard→scout→map→reduce for a large one).
613   const started = new Date().toISOString();
614   const t0 = Date.now();
615 
616   if (opts.analyze) {
617     try {
618       await runAnalyzeMode(opts);
619       writeRunRecord({
620         tier: 'scaled-analyze', started, ended: new Date().toISOString(),
621         input: `--project ${opts.project || process.cwd()} --objective ${JSON.stringify(opts.objective || '(default)')}`,
622         params: { mode: 'analyze' },
623         output: opts.output || '(stdout)',
624         result: 'analyze completed (see degraded stamp in the report)',
625         cross_model: false, models: null, duration_s: Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000), journal_ref: null,
626       });
627     } catch (err) {
628       process.stderr.write(`gandalf-run: --analyze failed — no output written.\n${err.message}\n`);
629       process.exitCode = 1;
630     }
631     return;
632   }
633 
634   // Read the ARTIFACT under analysis. (2026-07-11: the old grade-mode "router" pass is
635   // DELETED — it token-sized the draft JSON, logged model choices, and mutated
636   // GEMINI_MODEL/TRIO_MODEL env in a mode that makes zero model calls: pure ceremony
637   // with a misleading log and an env side effect. --analyze keeps the real router.)
638   let rawText;
639   try {
640     rawText = opts.input ? readFileSync(opts.input, 'utf8') : readStdin();
641   } catch (err) {
642     process.stderr.write(`gandalf-run: could not read input: ${err.message}\n`);
643     process.exitCode = 2;
644     return;
645   }
646 
647   let output, dispatch = null;
648   try {
649     if (opts.live) {
650       // C1: the LIVE cross-family path — refuters via agy, commissions minted into the
651       // shared ledger, cross_model/GROUNDED derived by the gate. HALTs honestly if agy
652       // is down (the seam throws; we write NOTHING and exit non-zero).
653       const live = await runHostLive(rawText, {
654         cross_model: true,
655         budget: opts.budget ?? undefined,
656         log: (m) => process.stderr.write(`${m}\n`),
657       });
658       output = live.output;
659       dispatch = live.dispatch;
660       const minted = dispatch.filter((d) => d.minted).length;
661       process.stderr.write(`gandalf-run: --live dispatched ${dispatch.length} refuter(s), ${minted} commission(s) minted\n`);
662     } else {
663       output = runHost(rawText, { cross_model: opts.cross_model });
664     }
665   } catch (err) {
666     // HONEST failure: malformed draft or a live-path error. Write NOTHING. Label revised
667     // 2026-08-25 (journal 0300, rule 9): the old blanket "(agy down / non-attested)" branded
668     // EVERY live error a substrate failure — twice misdiagnosing a budget stop as "agy down".
669     // Read err.message; it names the actual cause. (Budget excess no longer halts at all —
670     // it pre-flights and floors; see live-refuter.mjs.)
671     const kind = err instanceof SeamPassInputError ? 'malformed raw draft'
672       : opts.live ? `live refutation failed — ${err?.name || 'error'} (read the message below; NOT necessarily agy)` : 'conformance failure';
673     process.stderr.write(`gandalf-run: ${kind} — no output written.\n${err.message}\n`);
674     process.exitCode = 1;
675     return;
676   }
677 
678   const serialized = `${JSON.stringify(output, null, 2)}\n`;
679   if (opts.output) {
680     try {
681       writeFileSync(opts.output, serialized, 'utf8');
682     } catch (err) {
683       process.stderr.write(`gandalf-run: could not write output: ${err.message}\n`);
684       process.exitCode = 2;
685       return;
686     }
687   } else {
688     process.stdout.write(serialized);
689   }
690 
691   writeRunRecord({
692     tier: opts.live ? 'live-cross-family' : 'tier1-deterministic',
693     started, ended: new Date().toISOString(),
694     input: opts.input || '(stdin)',
695     // P0 2026-07-25 (journal 0276): --live hardcodes cross_model:true into runHostLive, so the
696     // intent stamp must reflect it — recording opts.cross_model alone stamped intent:false on
697     // every --live run, corrupting the training feed for the highest-value runs.
698     params: { live: opts.live, budget: opts.budget, cross_model_intent: !!(opts.live || opts.cross_model) },
699     output: opts.output || '(stdout)',
700     result: `graded: ${Array.isArray(output?.elevations) ? output.elevations.length : 0} elevation(s)` +
701       (dispatch ? `; refuters ${dispatch.length}, minted ${dispatch.filter((d) => d.minted).length}` : ''),
702     cross_model: output?.cross_model ?? false,
703     models: null,
704     duration_s: Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000),
705     journal_ref: null,
706   });
707 }

709 // Run as a CLI when invoked directly (node runtime/gandalf-run.mjs). Importable for tests otherwise.
710 // P0 2026-07-25 (journals 0275/0281/0283 + 0001-heavy-smoke): realpath + case-fold BOTH sides —
711 // a junction/symlink path in argv (e.g. ~/.claude/skills junctions) never string-equals the
712 // resolved module URL, so the CLI silently exited 0 writing NOTHING (the worst failure mode
713 // for an honesty-first host). realpathSync collapses junctions; toLowerCase absorbs Windows
714 // drive-letter/case variants.
715 function invokedDirectly() {
716   const entry = process.argv[1];
717   if (!entry) return false;
718   try {
719     const canon = (p) => {
720       const abs = resolve(p);
721       let real = abs;
722       try { real = realpathSync(abs); } catch { /* keep abs (file may be a virtual path) */ }
723       return process.platform === 'win32' ? real.toLowerCase() : real;
724     };
725     return canon(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) === canon(entry);
726   } catch {
727     return false;
728   }
729 }
730 if (invokedDirectly()) {
731   main().catch((err) => {
732     process.stderr.write(`gandalf-run: fatal — ${err?.message ?? err}\n`);
733     process.exitCode = 1;
734   });
735 }
736 
737 export { main };
